title: Substack article on the boxer upsets the wrestling community
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Substack article on the boxer upsets the wrestling community, about about two years ago at online, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, I wrote an article. I have a Substack, which I haven't done anything with in about a year, but I have a Substack. And I wrote an article about this particular event.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, says he wrote an article on his Substack, an online newsletter he admits he has barely used in a year, about an event involving a boxer. He says the piece upset people in the wrestling world.
